g.text: Methodological Scoping & Agreement Analysis (Secondary Sensitivity Study — NOT HUMAN VALIDATION):

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #1a202c

g.text: • Observed Raw Concordance: Po = 77.0% (77/100 claims) | 100% agreement on Directional, Fairness, & Performance categories.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #1a202c

g.text: • Agreement Metrics: Ternary Cohen's κ = 0.063 | Binary Collapsed κ = 0.045.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #1a202c

g.text: • Collapsed Matrix Representation: 3×2 space (Adjudicator UNDETERMINABLE = 0 cases; omitted from displayed matrix).

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #1a202c

g.text: • Kappa Paradox Mechanism: Extreme marginal imbalance (98% adjudicator supported vs. 2% contradicted) inflates expected

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #1a202c

g.text: chance agreement to Pe = 75.5%, drastically deflating chance-corrected κ despite high raw empirical agreement (Po = 77.0%).
